displayDescription: A dry-pen plotter traces a light bulb, lifts, travels and links a node network, finishing with a red ninth link.
motionEngine: GSAP (local gsap.min.js 3.15.1, one paused timeline at window.__timelines.video)
audioDescription: Silent preview: no music, effects or narration.
limitations: Illustrative procedural plotter: ink is an SVG stroke revealed by path length; no pen pressure, ink bleed or paper tooth is simulated.
The gantry, carriage and pen lift are a stylised 2D approximation of plotter hardware (lift shown by raised pen body, wider soft shadow and a hollow pen-up marker).
Plot speed is compressed to fit 3 seconds; draw speed is constant by path length, travel moves ease in and out.
STYLE.json lists no reviewed preview recipes and no BACKGROUND_REVIEW.json was supplied, so the preview demonstrates the core characteristic action (trace, lift, travel, resume) only.
Bed (#2E343B) and paper (#F2F2EE) follow the approved illustration; ink uses foreground #242831 and active #9F352D.
GSAP is the workspace-provided gsap.min.js; the dependency-selection record could not be written because this preview workspace has no project dependency file.
